import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,i,j = params[:10]
    s = np.sqrt(eps)
    num = a + b/T + s*(c + d/T) + eps*(e + f*np.sqrt(T))
    den = 1 + g*s + h*eps + j*eps/T
    return -eps*num/den
